name: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora
scope: Solo campaign only. Do not use in co-op or online.
notes: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora has no anti-cheat (only Denuvo DRM). Only use the cheats solo: co-op sessions are online and nobody there should be affected by you.

All AOBs were checked on Steam build 22429549 (afop.exe 1.0.2.2): each one is found exactly once on disk. Because of Denuvo, check the running game too: Vanta.exe --verify avatar-frontiers-of-pandora --live
Enable cheats only after your save has fully loaded. Fast travel and cutscenes reload values; toggle God Mode again if it stops working.
The Ubisoft Connect version is not detected automatically yet; point Vanta at afop.exe or start the game first.
Back up your save first (Ubisoft Connect\savegames\<account>\<game id>).

Skill Points, Spare Parts and RDA Duty Rosters are found when the game looks them up: open your inventory or the skills menu once. There is no public AOB yet for arrows, bow tension, one-hit kills, jumps or movement speed on this build, so those are not included.
Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora heeft geen anti-cheat (alleen Denuvo-DRM). Gebruik de cheats alleen solo: co-op-sessies zijn online en daar hoort niemand last van jou te hebben.

Alle AOB's zijn gecontroleerd op Steam-build 22429549 (afop.exe 1.0.2.2): elk wordt precies één keer gevonden op schijf. Controleer vanwege Denuvo ook de draaiende game: Vanta.exe --verify avatar-frontiers-of-pandora --live
Zet cheats pas aan als je save volledig geladen is. Fast travel en tussenfilmpjes laden waarden opnieuw; zet Godmode opnieuw aan als het stopt met werken.
De Ubisoft Connect-versie wordt nog niet automatisch gevonden; wijs Vanta naar afop.exe of start eerst de game.
Maak eerst een backup van je save (Ubisoft Connect\savegames\<account>\<game-id>).

Vaardigheidspunten, reserveonderdelen en RDA-dienstroosters worden gevonden zodra de game ze opzoekt: open één keer je inventaris of het vaardighedenmenu. Er is voor deze build nog geen openbare AOB voor pijlen, boogspanning, one-hit kills, sprongen of loopsnelheid, dus die zitten er niet in.
nl.scope: Alleen voor de solo-campagne. Niet gebruiken in co-op of online.

cheats.name: Inventory hook
cheats.confidenceNote: From a public Cheat Engine table (Paul44 v2.0 for game v2.5, January 2026). AOB (the table's 'Inventory' injection point) checked on Steam build 22429549 (afop.exe 1.0.2.2, 2026-09-28): exactly 1 hit on disk, and the surrounding bytes match the table's listing (list +0x08 items, +0x10 count; item +0x10 id). afop.exe is protected by Denuvo, so check the running game with Vanta.exe --verify avatar-frontiers-of-pandora --live. Not tested in-game yet. Vanta's own code (not the table's Lua): the original instructions run unchanged, then the list is scanned (max 1024 items) for the item ids of Spare Parts, Skill Points and RDA Duty Rosters listed in the table; only a matching item is remembered. All registers are preserved. Fails safe: if the AOB is not found exactly once, Vanta patches nothing.
